Dear Sir/Madam, 
 
 
Sub: Disclosure under Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure 
Requirements) Regulations, 2015 (“SEBI Listing Regulations”) - Audio recording of 
Earnings Conference Call for the quarter and financial year ended March 31, 2026 
 
 
This is with reference to the Company’s letter ref. no SIL/FY26-27/CS/27 dated May 
30, 2026 and pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Schedule III, Part A, Para A (15) of 
the SEBI Listing Regulations, it is hereby informed that the audio recording of the 
Earnings Conference Call held today i.e. Wednesday, June 3, 2026 is uploaded on the 
website of the Company and can be accessed on the below link: 
 
signpostindia.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/Q4FY26-con-call.mp3 
 
In compliance with Regulation 46 of the SEBI Listing Regulations, this intimation is 
also being uploaded on the website of the Company at www.signpostindia.com. 
 
Kindly take the above information on record. 
 
Thanking you, 
 
Yours Sincerely,  
For Signpost India Limited 
 
 
 
Kinjal Mistry 
Company Secretary & Compliance Officer 
 
KINJAL
